MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.32
Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.32
Upstream: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe

vision-0.10.32.js is the unmodified vision_bundle.cjs from the npm package.
vision-wasm.js and vision-wasm-nosimd.js are unmodified WASM loader scripts.
WASM binaries and Hand Landmarker model weights are downloaded on opt-in from
jsDelivr and Google's official MediaPipe model storage. Camera images are
processed in a local browser worker; this application does not upload them.
